description: Two-constant wave-only calibration; no dye observations or simulation outputs used.
method: Least squares of logarithmic characteristic steepness, single 3 cm unsheared deep-water carrier.

source.title: Public measured total along-wind characteristic steepness

caveats: Measured slope is the full observed surface, not a separately observed 3 cm parent band.
The calibration starts at measured age 15; coupled simulations start at measured age 16.
The physical wave-input stress cap is included in coupled runs but was inactive in this calibration fit interval.
The functional form is empirical; this does not identify parasitic-capillary loss as the unique mechanism.
Later measured waves are held out. No measured dye record is provided.
